class handling
document.paragraph: This section tests class handling for block level elements by the LaTeX writer. See the input file classes_latex.rst for the raw LaTeX code used to style the examples.
An "epigraph" directive is exported as "quote" wrapped in a "DUclass" environment. Here, it is styled by a "DUCLASSepigraph" environment redefining the "quote" environment as "minipage":

document.paragraph: Raw latex is also used to style the following lists: "DUCLASSenumerateitems" redefines "itemize" as "enumerate", "DUCLASSrules" draws horizontal lines above and below.
